01. 1.
This matter is taken up through Hybrid mode.
2. Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned Addl. Government Advocate for the State.
Perused the records.

3. This is an application under Section 438 of Cr.P.C. filed by the Petitioner for anticipatory bail,
arising out of Motu P.S. Case No.155 of 2023, corresponding to G.R. Case No.625 of 2023, pending before the Court of learned Additional Sessions Judge, Malkangiri, involving offence punishable under Sections 451, 323, 376, 34 of IPC subsequently it turned to Sections 450, 342, 376 of IPC read with Section 6 of POCSO Act.

entities.text: Court of learned Additional Sessions Judge, Malkangiri
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
4. Considering the submissions made by the parties, it is observed that the Petitioner, if so advised,
may surrender before the learned Additional Sessions Judge, Malkangiri, in the aforesaid case within four weeks from today.

In the event the Petitioner surrenders and moves for bail within the aforesaid period, learned Additional Sessions Judge, Malkangiri, shall do well to dispose of the bail application of the Petitioner on the same day on merit in accordance with law.
Further, while considering the bail application of the Petitioner, learned Court in seisin over the matter shall apply the principles of parity, if applicable.
The Case Diary as well as Medical Examination Report and the statements of the Victim recorded under Section 164 of the Cr.P.C. be made available to the Bishal @ Bisal Sana vs State Of Odisha .....
